label: EnGenius EnTurbo EAP1250 (tri-band 11ac Wave 2 indoor AP)
description: EnGenius EnTurbo EAP1250 tri-band 802.11ac Wave 2 indoor AP: 2.4/5/5 GHz, dual Gigabit Ethernet, 802.3af PoE.
notes: Vendor figures from the EnTurbo indoor AP datasheet: **tri-band 802.11ac Wave 2, 2.4/5/5 GHz**, **dual Gigabit Ethernet ports**, **802.3af PoE** for single-cable placement, mesh support. **Two radios on 5 GHz is the point**: it is built to serve dense rooms where one 5 GHz radio is the bottleneck, and the second port lets the AP be daisy-chained rather than home-run. Neither Ethernet port provides PoE *out* - the 802.3af is power *in*.
